players.bio: Álvaro Augusto is a professional footballer from Brazil who plays as a Center Back for FC Dallas.
Anderson Andrés Julio Santos (born 31 May 1996) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas.

Bernard Kamungo (born 1 January 2002) is a Tanzanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas. Club career Born in Kasulu, Kamungo and his family had lived in a refugee camp before being able to relocate to the United States and settle in Abilene, Texas. After moving to the United States, Kamungo was a member of the Abilene High School soccer team.
Brooks Thompson (born May 28, 2002) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer side FC Dallas on loan from Lexington SC in the USL Championship.
Christian Jaeger Cappis (born August 13, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a central midfielder for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas.

Clay Holstad is an American professional soccer player who plays as a central midfielder for FC Dallas in Major League Soccer (MLS), on loan from USL Championship side Rhode Island FC. Born on 12 January 2000 in Birmingham, Alabama, he is a versatile box-to-box midfielder known for his work rate and long-range shooting.

Daniel de Sousa Britto (born 6 May 1994) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes. Club career Born in Barra do Garças, Daniel started his youth career with the academy of União Rondonópolis.
Diego Garcia is a 19-year-old midfielder currently playing for FC Dallas. He primarily wears shirt #50 and is recognized as one of the club's promising Homegrown talents.
Enzo Newman is a professional footballer from United States who plays as a Right Back for FC Dallas.
Eric Quill (born February 28, 1978, in Missouri City, Texas) is an American soccer coach and former player. He is currently the head coach at Major League Soccer side FC Dallas.

Geovane de Jesus Rocha (born 31 July 2001) is a Brazilian footballer who plays for MLS side FC Dallas as a defender. Career Debut for Cruzeiro From Riacho de Santana, Bahia he played in the youth teams of Palmeiras before joining Cruzeiro in 2020. On 25 April 2021 he made his professional debut for Cruzeiro in the Campeonato Mineiro against Clube Atlético Patrocinense.
Herman Nils Johansson (born 16 October 1997) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for MLS club FC Dallas and the Sweden national team.
Joaquín Valiente Cioli (born 13 April 2001) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for FC Dallas in Major League Soccer.

Jonathan Sirois (born June 27, 2001) is a Canadian soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas. Early life Born in LaSalle, Quebec, Sirois grew up in Saint-Hubert, Quebec, where he played youth soccer with CS St-Hubert before moving to the Montreal Impact Academy in 2015, where he played for the U15, U17, and U19 teams.
Kaick da Silva Ferreira (born 29 November 2005), commonly known as Kaick, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for FC Dallas in Major League Soccer.

Alhassan "Lalas" Abubakar (born 25 December 1994) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a centre back for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas From 2014 to 2016, Abubakar attended the University of Dayton, where he played for the men's soccer team. Over three seasons, he made sixty one appearances for the team, scoring four times and assisting six times.

Logan Farrington (born December 4, 2001) is an American soccer player who plays for FC Dallas in Major League Soccer. Early life Farrington played youth soccer with the Milwaukee Bavarians, helping the team win a Wisconsin State Club Championship. He attended high school at Union Grove Union High School.
Don Deedson Louicius (born 11 February 2001), commonly known as Louicius Deedson, is a Haitian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for MLS club FC Dallas and the Haiti national team.
Michael Collodi (born 25 May 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas.

Nicholas Simmonds is a 19-year-old forward who currently plays for FC Dallas in Major League Soccer (MLS). He was selected as the 3rd overall pick in the 2026 MLS SuperDraft on December 18, 2025, after signing a Generation adidas contract.
Nolan Norris (born 17 February 2005) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas.
Osaze Urhoghide (born 4 July 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for FC Dallas.

Patrickson Luiggy Delgado Villa (born 17 October 2003) is an Ecuadorian footballer who plays as a midfielder for MLS side FC Dallas. Career Club career Before the second half of 2021–22, Delgado was sent on loan to Dutch side Jong Ajax. On 11 March 2022, he debuted for Jong Ajax during a 3–3 draw with FC Dordrecht.

Petar Musa (born 4 March 1998) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas and the Croatia national team. Career Musa made his debut in Czech First League for Slovan Liberec on 16 February 2019 in a 2–1 away loss against Baník Ostrava. He scored 14 goals in the 2019–20 Czech First League season and won the top scorer award with Libor Kozak.
Ramiro Moschen Benetti (born 22 May 1993), simply known as Ramiro, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays for FC Dallas. Mainly a defensive midfielder, he can also play as a right-back.
Ran Binyamin (Hebrew: רן בנימין; born 6 February 2004) is an Israeli professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas.
Samuel Sarver (born 3 March 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger for the Major League Soccer club FC Dallas.

Santiago Moreno (born 21 April 2000) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a winger for MLS club FC Dallas, on loan from Fluminense. Career Portland Timbers On 29 July 2021, Moreno signed with MLS side Portland Timbers on a contract until 2025.

Sebastien Uchechukwu Ibeagha (born January 21, 1992) is a professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas. Career Youth, college, and semi-professional Ibeagha joined the Houston Dynamo academy after he and his family moved to Houston, Texas from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

Shaquell Kwame "Shaq" Moore (born November 2, 1996) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back for Major League Soccer club FC Dallas and the United States national team. Shaquell Kwame "Shaq" Moore (born November 2, 1996) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back for Spanish Segunda División club Tenerife and the United States national team.
